hypotheses.A: A small same-origin cross-sectional tilt of priceOnly by issuer-specific residual-momentum rank supplies information less redundant than another fitted price model and can jointly improve price/return error and direction.
hypotheses.B: A sparse downside-only tilt for the bottom residual-momentum quintile when the issuer is below its 200-day mean can increase downside recall without violating error and false-warning guards.

featureDefinition: For each origin, average the cross-sectional percentile ranks of relative[9] (126-day residual cumulative log return) and relative[10] (252-day residual cumulative log return), then rank that average again and map its percentile to [-1,1]. Average ranks are used for ties. The feature snapshot was frozen before this protocol and every raw price through-date is earlier than origin.
candidateA: priceOnly * exp(0.025 * residualRankScore). Missing/unusable feature falls back to priceOnly.
candidateB: priceOnly * exp(-0.05) only for the bottom 20% final residual-rank percentile and absolute[4] < 0 (own price below its 200-day mean); otherwise priceOnly. Missing/unusable feature falls back to priceOnly.
evaluation: Reuse the frozen paired last-half evaluation rows from relative-v1: 9 origins for 126 trading days and 8 for 252. Every row is retained. This history has been inspected, so all results are exploratory quarantine evidence, never prospective evidence.
training: No fitted model, label selection, class balancing, or target-sign quota. Cross-sectional ranks use only same-origin features known before origin. Horizons are evaluated separately.
direction: Final numeric ratio >1.02 up, <0.98 down, otherwise neutral. Direction is always derived from the final numeric return; no classifier probability is attached.
weighting: Equal total weight per origin for pooled headline metrics; retain unweighted pooledAllRows, per-date, and regime metrics.
extraGate: Apply the existing blend gates against priceOnly and noChange: both date-mean MAPE and return MAE improve at least 2%, tails do not worsen, date win rate >=60%, direction/balanced direction/up/down recall/down precision pass. Also require falseDownWarningRate <= priceOnly and both errors <= simpleTrend. Prospective remains false.
probability: Not applicable: candidates emit numeric forecasts only. Brier/log loss are null and no score is represented as a calibrated probability.
abstention: No abstention; neutral predictions remain in the full sample. Missing inputs fall back and remain scored.
knownBias: Frozen data use current constituents/current sector labels and revised adjusted prices; point-in-time membership and delisted-issuer readiness remain 0/34. Therefore no promotion can result from this experiment.
